extension.summary: Callbacks for Kodi. Sends status to a UDP destination and/or the LoxBerry MQTT Gateway on player events (start, stop, pause, ...).
extension.description: UDP (virtual UDP input of the Miniserver), 24 possible strings: kodi_started, kodi_stopped, movie_started, movie_paused, movie_resumed, movie_stopped, movie_title=<title>, episode_started, episode_paused, episode_resumed, episode_stopped, episode_title=<title>, music_started, music_paused, music_resumed, music_stopped, music_title=<title>, unknown_started, unknown_paused, unknown_resumed, unknown_stopped, unknown_title=<title>, screensaver=on, screensaver=off. "unknown" means Kodi plays something it does not classify as movie, episode or music; without a title nothing follows the equals sign. MQTT via the LoxBerry MQTT Gateway, all topics retained, below the base topic (default kodi): event (the event name as above), movie_title, episode_title, music_title, unknown_title ("-" when there is no title), screensaver (on/off). On start the title topics are set to the current title or "-" and screensaver to the state Kodi reports. Python 3 (Kodi 19 Matrix or later).
